title: Founder Live Use Hardening
objective: Harden founder live-use workflows after full Command Center enablement without enabling unsafe execution.
safetyRules: No provider/model calls unless a later explicitly scoped phase admits them.
No agent dispatch unless a later explicitly scoped phase admits it.
No worker/tool execution unless a later explicitly scoped phase admits it.
No project creation or mutation unless explicitly allowed by a later phase.
No deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend.
No DemoApp exposure in full Command Center primary UX.
No raw private project IDs, raw logs, raw JSON dumps, raw policy dumps, or fake runnable actions.
reuseRequired: existing Founder Intake, Business Build, Agent Flow, Activity Log, and Docs pages
existing route matrix and founder Command Center boards

subphases.title: Contract / Scope / Safety Baseline
subphases.narrowGoal: Define P101 live-use hardening scope, safety baseline, allowed files, validation requirements, and future data shapes before coding behavior.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.futureEnvelope: P101.2 must define a result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, founderLiveUseMode, founderWorkflowReadiness, liveUseLanes[], safetyFlags, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, commandCenterVisible, and all unsafe runtime flags false.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: No UI change in P101.1. Future P101 UX must show founder live-use readiness, current state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner lanes, evidence/activity, cost impact, and what remains blocked without raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, DemoApp, raw private IDs, or runnable execution actions.
subphases.themeRequirements: No theme source change in P101.1. Future UX must preserve system, dark, and light themes.
subphases.playwrightTests: No Playwright update in P101.1 because no UI files change. P101.4 must add focused route coverage.
checkerUpdates: Update check:os-phase-status to accept P101.1-P101.7 and P102.
subphases.docsRoadmap: Add P101 plan doc and platform roadmap section.
subphases.phaseStatusUpdate: P101 in progress; P101.1 complete; current P101.1; previous P100.7; next P101.2.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm no provider/model call, agent dispatch, worker/tool execution, DB mutation, deploy, release, export, package, network, or spend path was added.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): define founder live use hardening contract"
